items.quote: Apply one rule to every factory push: `scripts/land-pr.sh`'s final push, the land queue's push (src/land/), and the delivery push (src/git/): **repository-level config is untrusted for the push; global and system config are trusted.**
for `core.sshCommand` use the global/system value if set, else `ssh`; never let a repository-scoped or included value apply.
URL-scoped keys (`credential.<url>.helper`, `url.<base>.insteadOf`/`pushInsteadOf`) from repository config must not apply either
